key_findings: All 17 sitemap URLs are 200, indexable, self-canonical, and server rendered with valid JSON-LD.
Five core YMYL pages now have licensed review, current dates, primary sources, and citation-ready answer blocks.
Mobile Lighthouse median is 56 with 9.44 second LCP; first-party render and hydration cost dominate.
The posts hub has 39 main-content words and the post sitemap has zero URLs.
The mobile consent panel obscures authority proof and the application entry.
FSRA records include Unit 2 while the website and local schema do not.

priority_issues.issue: Three mobile Lighthouse trials produced a median score of 56 and median LCP of 9.44 seconds.
No published editorial corpus exists; /posts has 39 main-content words and posts-sitemap.xml has zero URLs.
Garden-suite, multiplex, borrower, and investor hub pages are thin and lack the full review/source/internal-link layer.
The first-visit mobile consent panel covers authority proof and the application tabs.
The official Unit 2 address is inconsistent and FinancialService schema omits address and geo.
Critical-CH causes a likely document restart; the HTTP apex takes two redirects; 404 metadata is contradictory; CSP remains report-only.

recommendations: Reduce homepage hydration, DOM, unused JS/CSS, and below-fold client work.
Publish a reviewed private-mortgage resource cluster and expand thin YMYL pages.
Keep the application entry discoverable when the mobile consent panel is present.
Normalize Unit 2 and add PostalAddress/GeoCoordinates to FinancialService schema.
Configure GSC, GA4, CrUX/PageSpeed, GBP, Moz, and Bing evidence sources.
limitations: No Google Search Console, GA4, CrUX, GBP, Moz, Bing Webmaster, or DataForSEO credentials were available.
Performance evidence is Lighthouse lab data, not field CWV; INP is unavailable and was not inferred from TBT.
Backlink health is intentionally unscored because the evidence set is insufficient.
Public search absence is directional and does not prove deindexing or entity absence.
